title: TIPS anticipates cell fate from transient progenitor bottlenecks through network edge reweighting
description: Reproducible SEACells + MuTrans analysis pipelines that identify transitional cell states and transition-driver genes, applied to iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte differentiation (GEO GSE175634) and LARRY lineage-traced hematopoiesis (GEO GSE140802). Code accompanying the manuscript "TIPS anticipates cell fate from transient progenitor bottlenecks through network edge reweighting".
